plan.title: 4 tips for your first time
plan.sub: For volunteers and first-time facilitators. STEM teachers can skip ahead.
tips: Read the Crew Roles script word for word the first time. It's written to land.
Explain AI as "a friend who's never seen the picture." The clearer the words, the better the result.
If a pair gets stuck, suggest one change: add a color word, or say where things are.
Don't fix their prompts. The struggle is the lesson.
